== Selling ==  
Units sell for 25% of their deployment cost and upgrades.

== Trivia ==  

*Umbra's damage can only be buffed by [[Griffin (Reincarnation)|Griffin (Ascension)]], [[Blossom]], [[Idol (Star)]]
*He and his [https://animeadventures.fandom.com/wiki/Umbra unevolved form] are the second units to not deal Physical, Magic or Burn damage. Their case is ''purely'' true damage/dark.
*As of Update 19 the only relics that can be applied to Umbra are the [[Relics|Kunai]], [[Relics|Amplifying Codex]] and [[Relics|Infernal Gaze]] relics due to them being a True Damage unit.
*Umbra becomes Hybrid on his 6th Upgrade.
